def factor_volume_return_dir_corr_zscorevoldev(df):
    """Rolling correlation between daily return and z-scored volume deviation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    daily_ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_mean = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean()
    vol_std = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=5).std(ddof=1)
    vol_z = (df_copy["volume"] - vol_mean) / vol_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    corr = daily_ret.rolling(30, min_periods=20).corr(vol_z)
    factor = corr.fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_volume_return_dir_corr_zscorevoldev"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_return_dir_corr_zscorevoldev"]
description: Preserves parent's core mechanism of rolling correlation between signed daily returns and volume surprise to capture directional volume coherence. Mutation replaces the rolling percentile rank normalization of volume deviation with a continuous rolling z-score (volume - rolling_mean) / rolling_std. This removes the arbitrary rank nonlinearity and makes the volume surprise linearly comparable across time, aiming to improve Pearson IC while retaining the parent's strong RankICIR and long-short Sharpe. Parent strength target: RankICIR=0.424, long_short_sharpe=5.55, RankIC=0.0219. Bottleneck targeted: slightly improve IC and MI without degrading rank stability. No cross-sectional transform, preserving raw payoff evidence.
